evaluationScope: Independent static prediction against the supplied current Skill and five activation prompts. Predictions were written to independent-predictions.json before reading expected-SEPARATE.json or the previous forward-test artifact. The agent inherited task context, so this is not a fully blinded trial. No API model activation, tool execution, OAuth, persistence, human/operator attestation, or installed ChatGPT behavior was observed.

cases.result: Static prediction: browse installed character catalog through the connection guide and catalog discovery; catalog presence alone does not prove a legal draft choice.
cases.independentReason: The user explicitly names 5.5e SRD Oracle and requests its installed character catalog. The Skill owns catalog discovery.

cases.result: Static prediction: use the Oracle character workflow, establish a new Play Session and draft for legal character choices, and request detailed choices when the response lacks them. Hosted stateful play requires standard MCP OAuth, not credentials in chat.
cases.independentReason: A rules-supported SRD character and its available choices are the Skill's character-creation scope. Browse catalog presence separately from runtime-legal draft choices.

cases.result: Static prediction: read the same retained Play Session and fetch detailed remaining character choices if necessary; do not silently create a replacement journey.
cases.independentReason: This continues the preceding character journey. The Skill directs reading the retained Play Session and then detailed character choices, without silently starting another character.

cases.result: Static prediction: answer hobby history without activating this engine-workflow Skill.
cases.independentReason: A hobby-history overview is general D&D history, explicitly excluded from this engine-workflow Skill.

cases.result: Static prediction: activate the capability-boundary guidance and explain that executable custom monsters are not admitted by this installed-SRD-only engine; do not invent an import operation.
cases.independentReason: The user asks whether this particular SRD engine can execute authored content. Capability-boundary questions are included, and the Skill requires explaining the installed-catalog-only limit without inventing an import path.

observations: The Skill description explicitly includes installed catalog discovery, new or continued SRD character workflows, battle workflows, and engine capability-boundary questions. It explicitly excludes general D&D history and lore.
The current Skill directs initial ready Act calls through copied readyCalls arguments containing an opaque actKey; the server resolves the current selection.
Ordinary Battle answers use the current hole fact request and matching chatGptBattleOperations.inputs[].fillSchema, with pinned kind and holeId and only admitted fields.

The point-origin Sphere instructions distinguish tableSelectedPoint from a combatant-position anchor, require actual d20TestRoll for a rolled Saving Throw, and reserve explicit empty collections for confirmed absence.
Checkpoint and applied outcomes remain authoritative for HP, resources, narration and map displays; external positions and proposed geometry remain table facts.

These are static source-based predictions. No actual tool selection, generated tool inventory count, MCP calls, OAuth flow, storage transition, or installed-product behavior was certified by this review.

externalEvidenceStillRequired.scope: Remote Responses API MCP selection, and release-time installed ChatGPT and submission portal evidence as specified in the evaluation inventory.
